title: An Unholy Death
summary: A nun is found dead from smoke inhalation in her room. It was thought to be accidental since she’s a smoker and the room was locked from the inside.
method: The room was never locked. The killer put a piece of gum on the lock to make it look like there was a key. She pretended to unlock the door and then put the key on the inside. The killer lit a cigarette and put it at the foot of the bed, knowing the nun wouldn’t wake up because she had taken sleeping pills.
motive: The killer thought the nun and the priest were having an affair and wanted to save the church from scandal. Turns out they were father and daughter.
